_readme: Copy this file to config.json and edit it. config.json is gitignored -- it's yours, not shared, and digest.py falls back to its own built-in defaults if this file doesn't exist at all.
profile: Describe what you actually work on, in plain paragraphs. This is the only thing that decides what gets picked -- a modest paper on your stack beats a huge launch that isn't. Say what you build, the tools and languages involved, and what you explicitly don't care about (funding news, hype, punditry). See PROFILE in digest.py for the shape and length to aim for.
